texts.no_task_selected: Please select a task or create a new one
texts.run_mode_hint: Fast Mode: Faster without safety snapshot, but modifying files during sync may cause errors; Safe Mode: Creates safety snapshot, more secure for important data
texts.select_folder_hint: Select one or more folders, then click right buttons to apply strategy
texts.delete_task_confirm: Are you sure to delete selected tasks?
texts.clear_all_confirm: Are you sure to clear recently deleted list?
texts.recycle_limit_warning: Recently deleted folder exceeded storage limit ({limit}GB), please manually clean or adjust limit.
texts.config_upgraded: Config file auto upgraded to v7
texts.directory_conflict: This directory is being used by another task, please wait for it to complete.
texts.thread_hint: Set the number of threads for scanning and synchronization, range 2-8
texts.restore_default_config_confirm:
Are you sure you want to restore all settings to default?

• All task configurations will be cleared
• All settings will be reset to default
• Sync history and interrupted tasks will be cleared

This action cannot be undone. A restart is required after restoration.
texts.restore_default_config_done:
Configuration has been restored to default.

Please restart the application for changes to take full effect.
texts.filter_hint: Date filter and extension filter use AND logic - only files matching both conditions will be synced
texts.config_path_hint: Customize the directory for storing config files. Restart required after change.
texts.config_path_saved: Config path saved. Please restart the application to use the new path.
texts.task_import_export_hint: Export tasks to a JSON config file and import on another computer
texts.sync_stop_failed: Failed to stop sync, please try again
texts.security_interception: File {filename} blocked by security software (possibly a virus), skipped
texts.folder_filter_hint: Configure filter for selected folders (extension/date). Folders without filter sync all files.
texts.filter_dialog_hint: Date and extension filters are combined with AND; only files matching both are synced.
texts.date_range_empty: Fill at least one date to enable date filter
texts.ext_list_empty: Fill the extension list to enable extension filter
texts.export_all_confirm: No task selected. Export all tasks?
texts.recycle_limit_hint: Set the maximum capacity of the recycle bin. A cleanup prompt will appear when the limit is reached.
texts.sync_delete_default_hint: Set the default enabled state of sync delete. Can be temporarily changed on the sync confirmation page.
texts.sync_delete_checkbox: Sync Delete: Detect and delete files that existed before but are gone now
texts.sync_delete_warning:
⚠️ Warning:

• This feature deletes files. Make sure you no longer need these files.
• Deleted files are moved to Recycle Bin and can be restored there.
• Recommended only when you are certain.
texts.no_selection_hint: Please select one or more items first
texts.same_directory_error: Source and target directories cannot be the same
texts.language_hint: Select the interface language. The change takes effect immediately.
texts.language_broken_warning: The language file {filename} is corrupted and cannot be selected. Please check the file.
texts.multi_select_hint: Tip: Ctrl+click to select multiple, Shift+click to select a range
texts.life_protection_pausing_detail: ⏸️ Write protection: pausing writes (continuous write {minutes} min, {seconds} s remaining)
texts.fast_warning_1: • Fast mode does not create a safety snapshot
texts.fast_warning_2: • Modifying files during sync may cause version conflicts or data corruption
texts.fast_warning_3: • For up to 10 TB of files, the extra snapshot time in safe mode is usually only a few seconds
texts.rename_task_dialog_text:
Enter a new task name:
Current name: {name}
texts.multi_export_hint: Tip: To export only some tasks, go to Task Config and multi-select then export
texts.background_watch_hint: Watches the task's source folder in a separate process and syncs automatically after it stays idle for the set seconds. Watching continues after you close this app; reopen this page to stop it.
texts.watch_select_task_first: Please select a task to watch first
texts.watch_idle_invalid: Idle seconds must be an integer between 3 and 300
texts.feedback_hint: Found a bug or have a feature request? Feel free to open an issue:
texts.error_source_dir_missing:
Sync failed: source folder does not exist: "{path}"
Please check that the USB drive is plugged in.
texts.error_target_dir_missing:
Sync failed: target folder does not exist: "{path}"
Please check that the USB drive is plugged in.
texts.blocked_files_message:
The following files may have been blocked by antivirus software such as Windows Defender and were not synced.
Please verify they are safe; if you trust them, allow them in your antivirus and try again:
texts.post_sync_command_placeholder: A script or command to run after a successful sync; leave empty to disable
texts.post_sync_command_security_hint: Warning: make sure the command comes from a trusted source. Never run unknown commands.
texts.external_language_dir_hint: Put custom language files (.json) in this folder. They take priority over built-in languages; same-name files override built-in keys and take effect after restart.
texts.open_directory_failed: Failed to open the folder automatically, please go there manually:
texts.watch_idle_range_hint: Auto-sync after the source folder stays idle for this many seconds (range 3-300, default 10)
texts.watch_sync_idle: Not syncing right now (watcher is idle)
texts.auto_shutdown_checkbox: Shut down automatically after all sync tasks succeed
texts.auto_shutdown_hint: During the countdown you can click "Cancel Shutdown" in the bottom status bar. If any task fails, its state is kept and shutdown is cancelled.
texts.shutdown_aborted_failed:
The following tasks failed, so automatic shutdown was cancelled and the task states were saved as interrupted tasks:

{names}
texts.prevent_sleep_hint: Keeps the computer awake for the entire sync (including lifespan-protection pauses). Normal sleep behavior is restored after sync finishes (success, failure, or interruption).
texts.migration_sync_running_confirm:
A sync task is currently running. It is recommended to stop syncing before migrating, otherwise data may become inconsistent.

Continue?
texts.migration_sync_stop_failed: The sync task did not fully stop. Migration has been cancelled. Please try again later.
texts.migration_failed_rollback: Migration failed and has been rolled back. Please check disk space or permissions.
texts.migration_verify_failed_rollback: File verification on the new path failed and has been rolled back.
texts.migration_success_delete_old: Migration succeeded. Delete the old configuration?
texts.migration_success_delete_old_lang: Migration succeeded. Delete the old language directory?
texts.migration_delete_old_failed: A problem occurred while deleting the old configuration:
texts.migration_done_restart: Migration complete. It is recommended to restart the program for changes to take effect.
texts.migration_interrupt_note: Interrupted syncs have been saved as interrupted tasks. Please re-sync manually after the migration.
